export_model_to_executorch_xnnpack: export a PyTorch model to ExecuTorch with XNNPACK backend delegation using the xnnpack recipe
lower_exported_programs_to_executorch: lower exported PyTorch programs to ExecuTorch format using XnnpackPartitioner and memory planning passes
register_xnnpack_recipe: register the xnnpack recipe in the recipe registry for exporting models to ExecuTorch
check_custom_sdpa_in_graph: verify that the custom_sdpa operator is present in the exported program graph nodes
